race.comment: A very open feature. SWEYNESDAY (6) produced an outstanding run in the Group 3 Rising Fast down the Flemington straight on Derby Day, coming from near the tail of the big field at the half-way mark to be beaten a head. Perfectly placed over the extra trip and is poised to open his Australian account at the fifth attempt after plenty of success in NZ. DISNECK (11) also produced a massive finish in the Rising Fast, coming from last to be beaten just two lengths. Enjoyed the return to a dry track that day and it is essential he gets those conditions again. SIGNOR TORTONI (14) looks great value after a near miss behind Polyglot over 1100m at Randwick recently. Placed at all three runs over this distance and is beautifully weighted. LORD OF BISCAY (16) has been safely held in two runs this time in work but he likes Newcastle and has a strong record at this stage of the prep. GENERAL SALUTE (2) has been outstanding in two Group 3 runs this prep. Freshened up and certainly in the mix.
